items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I studied some clarinet with Joe Allard. We became good friends and I picked up some clarinet on him. In fact, I got into a little EMBROCHURE trouble one time and I had to go to him and he straightened it out in one lesson.

ctx.x: And then I used to listen -- at that time there was another clarinet player called -- soprano saxophone player, Boyd S Center, used to boy -- but I never played any solos with him. I used to listen to most all of the reed men, you know, on record. But Bechet and Hawkins are my pick at that time.

And then in later years when I came to New York I studied some clarinet with Joe Allard. We became good friends and I picked up some clarinet on him. In fact, I got into a little EMBROCHURE trouble one time and I had to go to him and he straightened it out in one lesson.
